# Test data

`searxng-response.json` is made up. It has the shape SearXNG 2026.9.15 answers
a JSON query in: `results` with `title`, `url`, `content`, `engine` and `engines`,
and `number_of_results` as 0 while `results` holds a full page. The addresses
are `example.com`, `example.org` and `example.net` only.
